newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates RBS Trust Bank.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates RBS Trust Bank.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it had assigned RBS Trust Bank Ltd (RBSTB) a long-term rating of AA minus, a short-term rating of A1 plus and a legal rating of 3.
"The company has already been approved by the Bank of England as an aurhorised insitiution and will begin operations in March," IBCA said in a statement.

"RBSTB has acquired the global custody, retail fund operations and related services - including stock lending, treasury and banking businesses - of SG Warburg & Co. This includes the business Warburg undertook for Mercury Asset Management Plc, the largest UK fund manager," IBCA said.
It also said the custody business of the Royal Bank of Scotland Plc would be gradually transferred to RBSTB.

"Once this process has been completed, RBSTB is set to establish itself as one of the two leading UK custodians and within the world's top ten largest custody operations, with some 250 billion stg assets under custody," the agency said.
IBCA said the majority of RBSTB's business was low risk, and a sound framework of procedures and controls mitigated credit, market and operational risks.

"Liquidity is good and RBSTB is well capitalised. Its ultimate parent is the Royal Bank of Scotland Group Plc (RBOSG), the seventh largest banking group in the UK. Given the standing of RBOSG, IBCA considers that shareholder support for RBSTB would be forthcoming if necessary," IBCA said.
